"""Mono instruments for Prism Courier. No sampled records or rendered phrases."""
from dataclasses import dataclass
import numpy as np

SR = 33452                          # 4 * the FT2 C-4 sample rate
TAU = 2*np.pi
rng = np.random.default_rng(0x63b718)
SAMPLES = []

@dataclass
class Sample:
    key: str
    name: str
    wave: np.ndarray
    loop: tuple
    rel: int
    pan: int
    volume: int
    fine: int
    filename: str


def freq(m):
    return 440 * 2**((m-69)/12)


def time(s):
    return np.arange(round(s*SR))/SR


def sin(p):
    return np.sin(TAU*p)


def cos(p):
    return np.cos(TAU*p)


def ramp(t, duration):
    return np.sin(np.clip(t/duration,0,1)*np.pi/2)**2


def openclose(t, attack, release):
    return ramp(t,attack)*ramp(t[-1]-t, release)


def unit(x, peak):
    return x*peak/np.max(np.abs(x))


def filtered(x, hp, lp, order=3, bump=None):
    n = len(x)
    f = np.fft.rfftfreq(n,1/SR)
    amp = 1 / (1+(f/lp)**(2*order))**0.5
    if hp:
        amp *= 1 / (1+(hp/np.maximum(f,1))**(2*order))**0.5
    if bump:
        for middle, gain, octave_width in bump:
            amp *= 1+gain*np.exp(-.5*(np.log2(np.maximum(1,f)/middle)/octave_width)**2)
    return np.fft.irfft(np.fft.rfft(x)*amp,n=n)


def positive_tail(t, tau, end):
    """Exponential transient, arriving at exact zero with soft slope at a loop."""
    return (np.exp(-t/tau)-np.exp(-end/tau)).clip(0)*ramp(np.maximum(end-t,0), min(.035,end*.4))/(1-np.exp(-end/tau))


def cyclic(root, attack_time, loop_time):
    cycles = int(round(freq(root)*loop_time))
    length = int(round(SR*cycles/freq(root)))
    start = int(round(attack_time*SR))
    n = np.arange(start+length)
    p = (n-start)/length
    return n/SR, cycles*p, p, (start,length)


def add(key, name, x, root=60, pan=128, v=48, loop=(0,0), peak=1., depth=16, fine=0, filename=None):
    y = unit(x,peak)
    if depth < 16:
        k=(1<<(depth-1))-1
        y=np.rint(y*k)/k
    y=np.rint(y*32767).astype(np.int16)
    assert len(name)<=22 and 0<=pan<256 and 0<=v<=64
    SAMPLES.append(Sample(key,name,y,loop,84-root,pan,v,fine,filename or name))

    result=np.zeros_like(p)

    return result

    body = sin(p)*np.exp(-t/.061) + .16*sin(2*p+.13)*np.exp(-t/.026)

        t=b*BAR*SPEED+ticks(row)
        d=ticks(dur)

        assert 0<v<=64 and 1<=n(note)-11<=96, (ch,b,note,v)
        ev=Event(t,n(note),ins,int(v),d,fx,carry,fade,tie,flags)

        self.special[(b*BAR+row,ch)]=cell

    def compile(self):
        mat=np.zeros((self.orders*ROWS,CHANNELS,5),dtype=np.uint8)
        for ch,lane in enumerate(self.lanes):
            for e in lane:
                e.row, e.delay = divmod(e.t,SPEED)
            lane.sort(key=lambda e: e.t)
            for e in lane:
                delay=e.delay
                assert not(delay and e.fx), (ch,e)
                assert not any(mat[e.row,ch]), ('note collision', ch, e, mat[e.row,ch])
                ins=self.instruments[e.ins] if not e.tie else 0
                note=e.note-11
                effect,param=e.fx or (0,0)
                if delay:
                    effect,param=0xe,0xd0+delay
                mat[e.row,ch]=(note,ins,16+e.v,effect,param)
            for i,e in enumerate(lane):
                next_t=lane[i+1].t if i+1<len(lane) else self.orders*ROWS*SPEED
                stop=min(next_t,e.t+e.dur) if e.dur else next_t

                if not e.dur or e.t+e.dur>=next_t or end_row>=len(mat):

                fade_row=end_row if end_delay>=3 else end_row-1
                fadeticks=end_delay if fade_row==end_row else SPEED-1
                faded=False

        mat=self.compile()
        if include is not None:
            for ch in range(CHANNELS):
                if ch not in include:
                    mat[:,ch]=0

            for cell in pattern.tolist():

                else:
                    dat.append(flags)

            b.extend(pack('<IBHH',9,0,ROWS,len(dat)))

        for s in self.samples:

        p=Path(path)
        p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        p.write_bytes(b)
        return p

"""Small FT2 sequencer and XM 1.04 writer, using tick positions internally."""
import re
import struct
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from collections import defaultdict
import numpy as np
from synthesis import synthesize

BPM=150
SPEED=6
BAR=16
ROWS=64
CHANNELS=16


def ticks(value):
    if isinstance(value,str):
        if value[-1] in 'abcde':
            return int(value[:-1])*SPEED + ('abcde'.index(value[-1])+1)
        return int(value)*SPEED
    return int(round(value*SPEED))


def n(note):
    if isinstance(note,int):
        return note
    match=re.fullmatch(r'([A-G])([b#]?)(-?\d)',note)
    pitch, accidental, octave = match.groups()
    i={'C':0,'D':2,'E':4,'F':5,'G':7,'A':9,'B':11}[pitch]
    return (int(octave)+1)*12+i+{'':0,'b':-1,'#':1}[accidental]


@dataclass
class Event:
    t: int
    note: int
    ins: str
    v: int
    dur: int
    fx: tuple
    carryfx: bool
    fade: bool
    tie: bool
    flags: str=''


class Song:
    def __init__(self, title, orders):
        self.title=title
        self.orders=orders
        self.lanes=[[] for _ in range(CHANNELS)]
        self.special={}
        self.samples=synthesize()
        self.instruments={x.key:i+1 for i,x in enumerate(self.samples)}

    def put(self,ch,b,row,note,ins,v,dur=0,fx=None,carry=False,fade=False,tie=False,flags=''):
        t=b*BAR*SPEED+ticks(row)
        d=ticks(dur)
        assert t>=0 and t<self.orders*ROWS*SPEED, (ch,b,row)
        assert 0<v<=64 and 1<=n(note)-11<=96, (ch,b,note,v)
        ev=Event(t,n(note),ins,int(v),d,fx,carry,fade,tie,flags)
        self.lanes[ch].append(ev)
        return ev

    def single(self,ch,b,row,cell):
        self.special[(b*BAR+row,ch)]=cell

    def compile(self):
        mat=np.zeros((self.orders*ROWS,CHANNELS,5),dtype=np.uint8)
        for ch,lane in enumerate(self.lanes):
            for e in lane:
                e.row, e.delay = divmod(e.t,SPEED)
            lane.sort(key=lambda e: e.t)
            for e in lane:
                delay=e.delay
                assert not(delay and e.fx), (ch,e)
                assert not any(mat[e.row,ch]), ('note collision', ch, e, mat[e.row,ch])
                ins=self.instruments[e.ins] if not e.tie else 0
                note=e.note-11
                effect,param=e.fx or (0,0)
                if delay:
                    effect,param=0xe,0xd0+delay
                mat[e.row,ch]=(note,ins,16+e.v,effect,param)
            for i,e in enumerate(lane):
                next_t=lane[i+1].t if i+1<len(lane) else self.orders*ROWS*SPEED
                stop=min(next_t,e.t+e.dur) if e.dur else next_t
                end_row, end_delay=divmod(stop,SPEED)
                if e.carryfx and e.fx:
                    # 0xy / vibrato continue until the gate. No effects cross into a new pitch.
                    for r in range(e.row+1, min(end_row+(end_delay>0),len(mat),(next_t//SPEED))):
                        if not any(mat[r,ch]):
                            mat[r,ch,3:]=e.fx
                if not e.dur or e.t+e.dur>=next_t or end_row>=len(mat):
                    continue
                # Dynamics near the end of longer gates are editable as volume slides.
                fade_row=end_row if end_delay>=3 else end_row-1
                fadeticks=end_delay if fade_row==end_row else SPEED-1
                faded=False
                if e.fade and e.t//SPEED<fade_row and not any(mat[fade_row,ch,:3]) and fadeticks:
                    step=(e.v+fadeticks-1)//fadeticks
                    if step<=15:
                        mat[fade_row,ch,3:]=(0xa,step)
                        faded=True
                if not faded:
                    if end_row==e.row and not any(mat[end_row,ch,3:]) and end_delay:
                        mat[end_row,ch,3:]=(0xe,0xc0+end_delay)
                    elif not any(mat[end_row,ch,:3]):
                        if end_delay:
                            mat[end_row,ch,3:]=(0xe,0xc0+end_delay)
                        else:
                            mat[end_row,ch]=(97,0,0,0,0)
        for key,val in self.special.items():
            mat[key]=val
        return mat

    def write(self,path,include=None,tempo=BPM):
        mat=self.compile()
        if include is not None:
            for ch in range(CHANNELS):
                if ch not in include:
                    mat[:,ch]=0
        pack=struct.pack
        def text(s,l):
            return s.encode('ascii',errors='replace')[:l].ljust(l,b'\0')
        b=bytearray(b'Extended Module: ' + text(self.title,20) + b'\x1a' + text('FastTracker v2.00',20) + pack('<H',0x0104))
        b.extend(pack('<I8H',276,self.orders,0,CHANNELS,self.orders,len(self.samples),1,SPEED,tempo))
        b.extend(bytes(range(self.orders)) + bytes(256-self.orders))
        for pos in range(self.orders):
            pattern=mat[pos*ROWS:(pos+1)*ROWS].reshape((-1,5))
            dat=bytearray()
            for cell in pattern.tolist():
                flags=0x80|sum(1<<i for i,k in enumerate(cell) if k!=0)
                if flags==0x9f:
                    dat.extend(cell)
                else:
                    dat.append(flags)
                    dat.extend(j for j in cell if j)
            b.extend(pack('<IBHH',9,0,ROWS,len(dat)))
            b.extend(dat)
        for s in self.samples:
            b.extend(pack('<I22sBHI',263,text(s.name,22),0,1,40))
            b.extend(bytes(263-33))
            b.extend(pack('<IIIBbBBbB22s',len(s.wave)*2,s.loop[0]*2,s.loop[1]*2,
                          s.volume,s.fine,0x10+(1 if s.loop[1] else 0),s.pan,s.rel,0,text(s.filename,22)))
            b.extend(np.diff(s.wave,prepend=np.int16(0)).astype('<i2').tobytes())
        p=Path(path)
        p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        p.write_bytes(b)
        return p

            for i in map(int,voices):

                if sound=='pad':

                else:
                    a=((0,1,0,2) if j%2==0 else (0,0,1,1))[i]
                    if tick==0 and b not in (1,5,9,14,17,33,37,41):
                        a=0 if i<3 else int(b%2==0)
                tick+=a
                v0=int(v)+([0,-1,-2,-4] if sound=='pad' else [0,-2,-2,-4])[i]
